name: Restaurant Canceled/Errors Order Recovery
tagline: Finds cancelled or mis-billed delivery orders and files the claims
description: Watches a restaurant's delivery portals for money that was lost to a cancellation or a charge at the wrong amount, then handles the reclaim. Each affected order gets its reimbursement request filed, and the day closes with one digest summarising everything that was recovered.
author: pattyshack
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
